purpose: Post-selection synthetic resolution sensitivity only; excluded from all model/pipeline/confidence selection
scale_evidence: work/r04_review/camera_gt_audit.json: approximate header pin pitch image measurement; not D455 intrinsics or calibrated board-plane scale

transform.storage: Downsampled RGB PNG; no explicit upsampling back to original image. Frozen evaluator may letterbox/upsample to1024 as in selected inference pipeline.
transform.gt_scaling: Use actual sx=new_width/old_width,sy=new_height/old_height on every target and excluded bbox, preserving IDs/classes/source types. Never clip out tiny labels or drop1px/subpixel objects.

execution_gate: Main two-arm evaluation aggregate complete, exactly four general/Pi main jobs, frozen main selection SHA and selected checkpoint/pipeline/confidence reused verbatim. This runner is not invoked by main suite.
selection_reuse: No threshold search, checkpoint search, native/dual change or choosing preferred model using stress scores
limitations: Only two public Pi photos, one source board group already inspected during development.
Nominal source px/mm is approximate; lens distortion, perspective, header height and exact board-plane scale are not calibrated.
Does not reproduce D455 optics, focus, noise, exposure, reflection, depth or camera-to-result delay.
Neither an upper nor a lower bound for actual D455 accuracy.
Derived source annotations remain geometric references even when downsampling makes identity visually unresolved; no human readability validation.
No score is used to select a checkpoint, pipeline, threshold or deployment model.
